An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the access control that is set and modified during the installation of the product. The product installation weakens existing access control restrictions of current system files, then sets weak access control restrictions on new files.
